{"reason": "suggest-alternative-supplier is dominated: 34 switches at 45000 yet stockouts remained (2.8d and 5.3d rows, alt-lead 4-7 too slow). Change that branch's action to monitor (0; 10-13.2d rows show regular delivery covers) and widen the expedite guard to medium risk, <6 days, so late-supplier rows like 5.3d get premium freight (35000, always on time).", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 6))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'monitor))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
